name: Jamf Pro Device Compliance
description: Fleet compliance review for Jamf Pro: what jamf_backup_check measures on Macs (FileVault, recovery key escrow, managed state, inventory and check-in age) and iOS/iPadOS (passcode, data protection, device-reported iCloud Backup), its finding codes and severities, drilling into single devices, safe remediation with the write-tier tools, and smart groups for ongoing visibility.
